name: The God of Fortune
description: The God of Wealth, the god in charge of the world's financial resources, embodies the simple emotions of the Chinese working people and entrusts their good wishes to live and work in peace and contentment, and to welcome good luck and receive blessings. Every Spring Festival, every household hangs a statue of the God of Wealth, hoping that the God of Wealth will bless them and bring wealth to their doorsteps. On the fifth day of the first lunar month, people still have the custom of welcoming the God of Wealth into their homes. People believe that inviting the God of Wealth into their homes will bring them abundant wealth and smooth sailing in the coming year. In daily life, people will also place statues of the God of Wealth at home to pray for blessings and prosperity in their homes.
